About AutoStacc

AutoStacc is where artists sell their sounds: sample packs, presets, stems, music and visuals, each credited to the project that made it.

For listeners and producers

  • Every product says who made it, and links to their project.
  • Checkout runs on Stripe; your card details never reach this site. No account needed to buy.
  • Your files are ready as soon as the payment is confirmed, and stay in Your Stacc to download again.
  • Follow a project and turn on Auto-Stacc to get its free releases automatically. Paid releases are only ever shown as new.

Browse the store

For creators

  • Claim your creator name in the Studio and build free pages for your projects, no code needed.
  • Sell packs, presets and more, and give your followers a community space your team runs.
  • Your pages are built from blocks: no outside code runs on AutoStacc, which keeps visitors safe.
